name: Volume Illustration Tone Shading
aliases: Modified Gooch tone shading for volume
Modified Gooch tone shading for volume models
definition: A non-photorealistic illumination model for volume rendering that combines gaseous illumination with directed shading based on the signed dot product between the volume sample gradient and the light vector. Unlike standard Gooch shading, the illuminated object contribution is zero at orientations orthogonal to the light vector, matching diffuse illumination models.
summary: Volume Illustration Tone Shading is a non-photorealistic model combining gaseous illumination with directed shading that uses continuous warm-cool color interpolation and clamped dot products to enhance shape perception.
